prompt: Continue Phase 6 by adding deterministic checkpoint lifecycle transitions. Create src/ade/checkpoint_transition.py with pure provider-agnostic helpers that produce validated TaskCheckpoint values for: a newly started/running CycleSession; a completed CycleResult; and a RepairPlan final disposition. RETRY is not a terminal checkpoint transition and must be rejected by the final-disposition helper. Map PAUSE_QUOTA to PAUSED_QUOTA, HUMAN_WAIT to HUMAN_WAIT, REPLAN to REPLAN, and FAIL to FAILED. Preserve next_attempt/next_replan_count and bounded error/failure kind from the RepairPlan. Allow an optional provider_session_id and optional resume_after only where the TaskCheckpoint model permits them. Do not mutate inputs and do not persist anything in this module. Export the public helpers from ade.__init__. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage for running, completed, quota pause with/without session id, human wait, replan, fail, RETRY rejection, and task-id mismatch rejection. Do not add dependencies. Do not modify GOAL.md, SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, pyproject.toml, .github/workflows, scripts, or any .autodev files. Run exactly PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v before finishing.
title: Add checkpoint lifecycle transitions
